function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS usd_lines, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, AVG(unit_price_orig) AS avg_unit_price_orig, AVG(fx_rate) AS avg_fx
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE currency='USD' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period","purpose":"Check USD purchase lines in Aug and Sep 2026"}
